Займенники на -self і -selves: коли дія: Pronouns ending in -self and -selves: when an action goes back to the person doing it (I hurt myself), when it means “alone, without help” (by myself), and how each other differs from themselves. Plus verbs that are reflexive in Ukrainian but need no pronoun in English: feel, relax, meet.
